title: AI Proposal Review and Insights UI Foundation
goal: Expose AI reasoning and pending proposals to operators with explicit review controls and audit truth.
scope: Add API and Mission Control UI surfaces for AI reasoning records, pending proposals, approve/reject decisions, and an Insights panel that shows reasoning provenance. Approved proposals may only enter existing operator-controlled flows and must not bypass scope, approval, pack validation, deployment, or runtime binding.
generation_reason: AI_PENTESTING_AGENT.md requires operator-visible proposals, reasoning transparency, and approve/reject controls before AI suggestions are useful.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Review UI only. Do not create a shadow task queue, auto-approve intrusive actions, or hide proposal provenance.

success_criteria: Operators can list reasoning records and proposals for a selected run.
Proposal approval/rejection is auditable and actor-attributed.
UI copy distinguishes suggestions from executed tasks.
Approval paths reuse existing run/profile/approval controls instead of bypassing them.
Tests cover read, approve, reject, disabled, and forbidden-action cases.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: AI proposals are visibly review-only until approved.
Approval or rejection is audit logged.
No approval path bypasses existing platform gates.

before_promotion: Post-task AI analysis proposal foundation is completed and logged.
Operator review statuses and forbidden action classes are documented.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with proposal review UI changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with AI proposal review behavior and remaining execution limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
